item_description:
Script: dpe tshugs.
The title on the cover page and the incipit were presumably highlighted in color, and are not legible on the reproduction.
Number on the last folio: 87.
Two folios - numbered 57 and 57 'og ma - between fol. 56 and fol. 58.
